headline: Software links GWAS, eQTL and single-cell data to prioritize cell types and effector genes
label: Statistical Genomics Analysis Tooling
summary: Nine tools and resources integrate human genetics with single-cell, spatial and bulk omics for gene and cell-context prioritization.
synthesis: The items do not form an isoform-resolved thread; the dominant theme is software that connects human genetic or perturbation signals to cell and tissue context. EPIC2 ranks trait-relevant cell types by combining GWAS summary statistics with single-cell chromatin accessibility under LD. CAS-X and CELL-X prioritize type 2 diabetes effector genes using multi-tissue eQTL fine-mapping and islet single-cell atlas data, respectively. CellColocDB and the IGVF Catalog provide queryable resources, the latter a knowledge graph of ~3B nodes and 8.6B edges with an LLM interface. Methodological tools include RapidGLM (2.5-17.8x faster count regression), spicyR v2 (permutation-free co-localisation), ARC-Impute (spatial gene imputation) and CATEomics (CATE model selection). None of the items addresses isoform resolution.
